main_body: dead weeping tree with hanging branches and trunk
top_band: upper crown of branches and arch tops with brown highlights (rows 0-20)
evidence: Organic weeping tree. The hanging canopy overlaps and shadows the trunk (rows 30-55), which has a 3/4 cylindrical shading and a rounded root base (rows 52-55), though the base sits on a flat horizontal line at row 55.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees with organically splayed root systems and rich volumetric clusters, this tree has a flat, horizontal slab-like base at the bottom, heavy near-black outlines around individual hanging strands, and repetitive vertical lines.
